examples_en: He gave me his phone number so we could keep in touch. | They kept in touch for twenty years. | Please keep in touch while you are traveling. | A: I'm going to live in America next year. | B: After you go, please keep in touch with me.
arabic: يبقى على تواصل، يظل على اتصال
definition_ar: الحفاظ على التواصل مع شخص ما عن طريق التحدث أو الكتابة.
examples_ar: وعدنا بأن نبقى على تواصل بعد التخرج. | دعنا نبقى على تواصل عبر البريد الإلكتروني.

examples_en: keep on pushing! | His alarm went off, but he kept on sleeping. | It's late, but I have to keep on working. | A: Why did you sell your parrot? | B: He kept on singing Elvis songs.
definition_ar: الاستمرار في فعل شيء ما دون توقف.
examples_ar: واصل العمل رغم شعوره بالتعب. | إذا استمريت في التدريب، فسوف تتحسن.

examples_en: They wanted to keep an eye on the strange newcomer. | I'm going to the bathroom. | Please keep an eye on my bag. | My parents are gone, so I have to keep an eye on my little brother. | A: Keep an eye on the time. | I have to leave at midnight. | B: OK. | It's only 11:15 now.
arabic: يراقب، يعتني بـ، يضع عينه على
definition_ar: مراقبة أو الاعتناء بشخص أو شيء ما بعناية.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك مراقبة حقيبتي بينما أذهب إلى دورة المياه؟ | وعد الجيران بمراقبة منزلنا بينما نحن بعيدون.

examples_en: keep your hands out of::... your hands ... my honey! | The children were kept out of the graveyard. | The high fence kept wolves out of::... wolves ... the farm. | A: Why did you keep out of the game? | B: I don't know how to play very well.
definition_ar: تجنب التورط في موقف ما أو منع شيء من الدخول إلى مكان.
examples_ar: أحاول أن أبتعد عن خلافاتهم العائلية. | من فضلك ابقِ الكلب خارج المطبخ.

examples_en: People always laugh at his nose. | The thoughtless teacher laughed at the student when he made a mistake. | They laughed at him when he tripped. | A: Why is Jimmy crying? | B: The other children laughed at his haircut.
definition_ar: إظهار أنك تجد شخصاً أو شيئاً مضحكاً، وغالباً ما يكون ذلك بطريقة غير لطيفة.
examples_ar: ليس من اللطيف السخرية من الأشخاص الذين يرتكبون الأخطاء. | ضحك الفصل بأكمله على زيه المضحك.

examples_en: The road leads to the castle. | The guide will lead us to::... us ... the village. | The dog led the police officer to::... police officer ... the robber's house. | A: Where does this stairway go? | B: It leads to the parking garage.
definition_ar: أن ينتج عن شيء ما موقف أو حدث معين.
examples_ar: العمل الجاد سيؤدي إلى النجاح. | هذا الطريق يؤدي إلى النهر.

examples_en: The message was nice, but they left out the A's! | He packed his suitcase, but he left out one pair of socks. | This argument is between you and me. leave my brother out::... my brother ... of it. | A: Do you want a hamburger? | B: Yes I do, but please leave out the pickles.
definition_ar: عدم تضمين شخص أو شيء ما.
examples_ar: يمكنك حذف الملح إذا كنت تتبع حمية غذائية. | شعر بأنه مستبعد لأنه لم يُدعَ.

definition_en: give attention in order to hear; hear
examples_en: He likes to listen to music. | She listens to the radio on her way to work. | We sat outside and listened to the birds singing. | A: Why is Rita doing so badly in school? | B: She never listens to her teacher.
definition_ar: إعطاء الاهتمام للصوت أو لشخص يتحدث.
examples_ar: أحب الاستماع إلى الموسيقى الكلاسيكية. | يجب أن تستمع إلى والديك.

examples_en: little by little, the snail moved along the road. | Peter learned Spanish little by little. | Little by little, they built their house. | A: Your computer is expensive. | How did you buy it? | B: I worked for three years and saved my money little by little.
definition_ar: ببطء وبكميات صغيرة.
examples_ar: شيئاً فشيئاً، تعلمت التحدث باللغة العربية. | ذاب الثلج شيئاً فشيئاً.

definition_en: keep oneself alive with food or money; survive (on)
examples_en: The bird lives on worms. | The poor man lived on bread and water. | In college, I lived on only $50 a week. | A: Let's go out for a nice dinner. | B: Good idea! | I am tired of living on spaghetti and water!
definition_ar: اعتماد نوع معين من الطعام كمصدر أساسي للغذاء أو العيش بمبلغ محدد من المال.
examples_ar: إنهم يعيشون على دخل ضئيل جداً. | العديد من الحيوانات تقتات على الحشرات.

examples_en: She longs for romance. | The orphan longed for a home. | He longed for a motorcycle of his own. | A: I'm longing for the ocean. | B: Okay. | Let's go to the beach.
definition_ar: الرغبة الشديدة في شيء ما، خاصة إذا كان من الصعب الحصول عليه.
examples_ar: إنها تتوق إلى أيام شبابها. | كان يتوق إلى حياة هادئة في الريف.

examples_en: She must look after her puppy. | I had to look after my little sister. | Please look after my plants while I am gone. | A: I'll be gone for one week. | Will you look after my dog? | B: Yes. | I'll give him food and walk him every day.
definition_ar: الاهتمام بشخص أو شيء ما.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك الاعتناء بقطتي بينما أنا بعيد؟ | إنها تعتني بوالديها المسنين.

examples_en: He is looking around for bananas. | We looked around the room for the remote. | The new student looked around the class. | A: I still haven't found my bag! | B: Look around at school tomorrow. | Maybe it's there.
definition_ar: زيارة مكان لرؤية ما فيه، أو الالتفات برأسك لترى ما حولك.
examples_ar: قضينا فترة بعد الظهر في التجول لاستكشاف المدينة. | التفت حوله ليرى من يناديه.

definition_en: have a look at; take a look at; stare at
examples_en: They looked at each other for a long time. | The doctor looked at the X-ray. | Dawn looked at the painting. | A: Look at those beautiful flowers! | B: Wow! | I don't think I've seen any like those before.
definition_ar: توجه النظر نحو شخص أو شيء، أو دراسة أمر ما.
examples_ar: الرجاء النظر إلى اللوحة بينما أشرح. | إذا نظرت إلى النتائج، ستلاحظ تحسناً.

definition_en: despise; think you're better than someone else
examples_en: He was often looked down on for being different. | The scholar looked down on the farmer. | The rich man looked down on the beggar. | A: Why do those rich kids look down on Sarah? | B: Because Sarah's family is poor and she wears old clothes.
definition_ar: اعتبار المرء نفسه أعلى شأناً من شخص آخر ومعاملته باحتقار.
examples_ar: يجب ألا نحتقر أبداً الأشخاص الأقل حظاً. | يميل إلى الاستخفاف بزملاء العمل الذين لديهم خبرة أقل.

definition_en: try to find; search for; seek
examples_en: He's looking for grass to eat. | What are you looking for? | Can you help me look for my glasses. | A: Can I help you? | B: Yes. | I'm looking for the restroom.
definition_ar: محاولة العثور على شخص أو شيء، أو توقع نتيجة معينة.
examples_ar: أنا أبحث عن مفاتيح؛ هل رأيتها؟ | الشرطة تبحث عن السيارة المفقودة.

examples_en: He is looking forward to the game. | I am looking forward to my new job. | We are looking forward to leaving this town. | A: I'm looking forward to our vacation next month. | B: Me too. | It's going to be fun!
arabic: يتطلع إلى، ينتظر بفارغ الصبر، يتقرب بحماس
definition_ar: الانتظار بشغف وترقب لمزيد من السرور.
examples_ar: أتطلع إلى لقائك الأسبوع القادم. | الأطفال يتطلعون بشغف إلى رحلتهم المدرسية.

definition_en: resemble; have the appearance of; take after
examples_en: Sometimes, people look like their pets. | A tiger looks like a big cat. | That guy looks like my brother. | A: Can you see that cloud?! | B: Wow! | It looks like an elephant!
definition_ar: امتلاك مظهر مشابه لشخص أو شيء ما، أو إعطاء انطباع بالاحتمالية.
examples_ar: هي تشبه والدتها. | يبدو أننا سنفوت رحلتنا الجوية.

definition_en: be careful; take care; watch out
examples_en: look out! | You must look out for cars when you cross the street. | Look out! | That rock is about to fall. | A: Look out! | You almost stepped on my mouse. | B: Sorry. | I didn't see it.
definition_ar: أن تكون يقظاً وتنتبه لما يحدث حولك، خاصة لتجنب الخطر.
examples_ar: انتبه! هناك سيارة قادمة. | يجب أن تنتبه للبقع الزلقة على الطريق.

definition_en: search many things to find something
examples_en: She looked through the whole house until she found her spider. | I looked through the drawer for an eraser. | The woman looked through her purse for her car keys. | A: Did you find any mistakes when you looked through my essay? | B: Yes, I found a couple.
arabic: يتصفح، يراجع بسرعة، ينظر من خلال
definition_ar: فحص أو تصفح شيء بسرعة، مثل كتاب أو أوراق أو مستندات.
examples_ar: أحتاج إلى تصفح هذه المستندات قبل التوقيع. | تصفحت ملاحظاتها قبل الامتحان.

examples_en: The boy really looks up to his older brother. | Jim looked up to his brave friend. | We all look up to our grandfather. | A: Why do you look up to Tim so much? | B: Because he is a brave, honest and humble person.
definition_ar: الإعجاب بشخص واحترامه بشدة.
examples_ar: غالباً ما يتخذ الرياضيون الشباب نجوم الرياضة المحترفين قدوة لهم. | طالما احترمت أختها الكبرى واتخذتها قدوة.

examples_en: The monkey wants to make friends with the snake. | I made friends with the new boy in school. | It can be hard to make new friends::... new .... | A: I'm going to go to a new school next year and I'll miss my friends. | B: Don't worry. | You'll make friends with people at your new school too!
arabic: يصادق، يتعارف على، يكوّن صداقة مع
definition_ar: بدء علاقة صداقة مع شخص ما.
examples_ar: من السهل عليه تكوين صداقات مع زملائه الجدد في الفصل. | انتقلت إلى مدينة جديدة وصادقت جيرانها بسرعة.

definition_en: make unkind jokes about; tease; pull one's leg; make a fool of
examples_en: Everyone made fun of him. | She made fun of my ugly shoes. | The other reindeer made fun of Rudolph's red nose. | A: Ha-ha-ha! | You can't ski! | B: Don't make fun of me! | This is my first time skiing.
arabic: يسخر من، يهزأ بـ، يستهزئ بـ
definition_ar: الضحك على شخص أو جعل الآخرين يضحكون عليه بطريقة غير لطيفة.
examples_ar: ليس من الجميل السخرية من الأشخاص الذين يرتكبون أخطاء. | اعتاد الأولاد الأكبر سناً السخرية من لهجته.

examples_en: He is making himself at home on the sofa. | Come in! make yourself at home. | I made myself at home in my friend's apartment. | A: Can I use one of your towels? | B: Sure! | You can use anything you need. make yourself at home.
arabic: يعتبر المكان مكانه، يستريح كأنه في منزله، يأخذ راحته
definition_ar: الشعور بالاسترخاء والراحة وكأنك في بيتك الخاص عند زيارة الآخرين.
examples_ar: تفضل بالدخول واعتبر المكان مكانك. | عندما وصلت إلى منزلهم، أخبروني أن أخذ راحتي تماماً.

definition_en: have a clear meaning be understandable
examples_en: His words didn't make sense. | It makes sense to stop smoking. | The sentence makes no sense::... no .... | A: Does that make sense? | B: No, it doesn't. | Maybe if you explain it again I'll understand.
definition_ar: أن يكون الشيء منطقياً أو معقولاً أو سهل الفهم.
examples_ar: شرحه يبدو منطقياً بالنسبة لي. | هل من المنطقي شراء سيارة جديدة الآن؟

examples_en: He is making the most of his arms to build his house quickly. | She is making the most of a bad situation. | I only have ten dollars. | I'll have to make the most of it. | A: It's too bad that you have to leave soon. | B: I know. | Let's just try to make the most of our time together.
arabic: يستغل أفضل استغلال، يحقق أقصى استفادة
definition_ar: استخدام أو الاستمتاع بشيء ما إلى أقصى حد ممكن.
examples_ar: يجب أن نستغل هذا الطقس الجميل إلى أقصى حد. | حاولت أن تستفيد من إجازتها القصيرة قدر الإمكان.

examples_en: He often made up stories. | My grandfather makes up funny songs. | I didn't want to tell the man my real name, so I made up a name. | A: You'll be late for school. | What will you tell the teacher? | A: I'll make up an excuse.
definition_ar: اختراع قصة أو تفسير، غالباً بهدف الخداع.
examples_ar: اختلق عذراً لتأخره. | يحب الأطفال ابتكار ألعاب في الحديقة.

examples_en: She started slowly, so she is trying to make up for lost time. | She had to work overtime to make up the days of work she missed. | He missed his daughter's birthday, so he tried to make up for it with a big gift. | A: Why did you buy my lunch today? | B: I wanted to make up for being late last week.
definition_ar: التعويض عن شيء مفقود أو ضائع.
examples_ar: العمل الجاد يمكن أن يعوض نقص الخبرة. | آمل أن تعوض هذه الهدية غيابي.

examples_en: He is trying to make up his mind::... his .... | You have to make up your mind::... your ...! | I can't make up my mind::... my .... | A: Is Jill going to study in America or Canada? | B: She made up her mind::... her ... to study in Canada.
definition_ar: اتخاذ قرار نهائي بشأن شيء ما.
examples_ar: لم أحسم أمري بعد. | اتخذت أخيراً قرارها بالدراسة في الخارج.

examples_en: After a big argument, they wanted to make up with each other. | I don't think I can ever make up with him. | Newlyweds fight and make up often. | A: Why are you going to go to a movie with Tom? | I thought you were angry at him. | B: I was angry at him, but we made up with each other. | Now we're good friends again!
definition_ar: العودة إلى الصداقة بعد خلاف أو شجار.
examples_ar: تصالحا أخيراً بعد الجدال. | حان الوقت لتتصالح مع أخيك.

examples_en: Farmers make use of the land. | He made use of the wood and built a house. | Can you make use of some old chairs. | A: Is Ben making use of his math skills? | B: Yes he is. | He works at a bank.
definition_ar: استخدام شيء ما لغرض معين.
examples_ar: يجب أن نستفيد من موارد المكتبة. | يمكنك استخدام سيارتي أثناء غيابي.

definition_en: easy; no trouble; it doesn't matter
examples_en: He hopes that fixing the window will be no problem. | It should be no problem to find tickets for the game. | She said it was no problem to pick me up. | A: Thanks for the cookie! | B: No problem. | I have a whole bag of them.
arabic: لا مشكلة، على الرحب والسعة، حاضر
definition_ar: طريقة مهذبة للقول بأنك سعيد بالمساعدة أو أن شيئاً ما ليس مشكلة.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟ لا مشكلة! | شكراً على التوصيلة. لا مشكلة.

definition_en: only; no more than; merely; just
examples_en: Robbers are nothing but bad. | That boy is nothing but trouble. | There was nothing but old cheese in the refrigerator. | A: Your car looks nice. | Is it a good car? | B: No. | I bought it two years ago and it has given me nothing but problems.
definition_ar: تُستخدم للتأكيد على أن شيئاً ما هو الشيء الوحيد الموجود أو المعني.
examples_ar: لم تكن الغرفة سوى فوضى عارمة. | هو لا يريد شيئاً سوى أن يُترك وشأنه.

definition_en: sometimes; occasionally; once in a while at times; from time to time
examples_en: now and then he likes to sing. | He likes to watch a movie now and then. | Now and then there are concerts in the park. | A: Do you come to this restaurant often? | B: No. | I only come here now and then.
arabic: من حين لآخر، بين الحين والآخر
definition_ar: أحياناً، ولكن ليس كثيراً.
examples_ar: أراه من حين لآخر في الحديقة. | تزور مسقط رأسها من حين لآخر.

examples_en: of course I like your hairstyle. | If you are busy, you don't have to come, of course. "Can we go to the concert?" "of course we can.." | A: Do you like soccer? | B: Of course I like soccer! | That's why I play it every day!
definition_ar: تُستخدم لإظهار أن شيئاً ما بديهي أو متوقع.
examples_ar: بالطبع، أنت مدعو إلى الحفلة. | سيتأخر بالطبع مرة أخرى.

examples_en: The road goes on and on. | They worked on and on through the night. | It rained on and on for days. | A: Did your aunt call last night? | B: Yes! | She talked on and on for three hours!
definition_ar: الاستمرار لفترة طويلة دون توقف.
examples_ar: تحدث باستمرار وبلا توقف عن رحلته. | استمرت الموسيقى في العزف طوال الليل دون توقف.

examples_en: He made the journey on foot. | You can go everywhere on foot in my town. | They had to go on foot after their car broke down. | A: Do you go to school by bus? | B: No, I don't. | I go on foot.
definition_ar: المشي بدلاً من استخدام وسيلة نقل.
examples_ar: قررنا الذهاب إلى المحطة سيراً على الأقدام. | من الأفضل استكشاف وسط المدينة سيراً على الأقدام.

examples_en: I'm sorry I spilt the drink. | It wasn't on purpose. | He missed the school bus on purpose because he didn't like school. | She broke the cup on purpose. | A: Hey! | Did you hit me on purpose? | B: No I didn't. | It was an accident.
definition_ar: بشكل متعمد؛ ليس عن طريق الخطأ.
examples_ar: كسر الزجاج عن قصد. | لم أقصد إيذاءك؛ لم يكن ذلك متعمداً.

examples_en: The bus usually arrives on schedule. | The meeting did not start on schedule. | I hope that my plane is on schedule. | A: Will the train be late today? | B: No, it will arrive on schedule.
definition_ar: يحدث أو يتم في الوقت المخطط له.
examples_ar: وصل القطار في الموعد المحدد تماماً. | نحتاج إلى إنهاء المشروع في الموعد المحدد.

examples_en: He's not lazy. on the contrary, he is very active. | ''Are you cold?" "on the contrary! | I'm quite warm!" You don't look exhausted. on the contrary, you seem very healthy. | A: Was that movie bad? | B: On the contrary, it was the best movie I've ever seen!
definition_ar: تُستخدم لتوضيح أن عكس ما قيل للتو هو الصحيح.
examples_ar: أنا لا أكرهه؛ بل على العكس، أنا أحبه كثيراً. | لم تكن رحلة سيئة؛ بل على العكس، كانت رائعة.

definition_en: going or coming; during the journey
examples_en: There is a gas station on the way to the next city. | On the way to work this morning she saw a deer. | I will stop by the post office on my way::... my ... home. | A: We don't have any milk. | Can you buy some today? | B: Okay. | I'll buy some on the way home | from school today.
definition_ar: أثناء السفر أو الانتقال إلى مكان معين.
examples_ar: سأشتري بعض الحليب وأنا في طريقي إلى المنزل. | إنه في طريقه إلى المكتب.

examples_en: They are going fishing on the weekend. | We used to go hiking on weekends. | I take my son to the park on the weekend. | A: What are you going to do on the weekend? | B: I'm going to play soccer on Saturday and go to church on Sunday.
definition_ar: خلال فترة يومي السبت والأحد.
examples_ar: نحن عادة نذهب للتنزه في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع. | هل ستفعل شيئاً مميزاً في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع؟

examples_en: He wanted to get to his meeting on time. | Most of the people came on time. | This train is always on time. | A: Let's go to school now. | I don't want to be late for class. | B: Don't worry. | We'll be on time.
arabic: في الموعد المحدد، في الوقت المناسب
definition_ar: في الوقت الصحيح أو المحدد تماماً؛ في الميعاد.
examples_ar: وصل القطار في الموعد المحدد. | من المهم الحضور في الموعد المحدد للاجتماع.

definition_en: sometimes; occasionally; now and then; at times
examples_en: once in a while, I like to eat seafood. | My old friend calls me once in a while. | Once in a while, he goes to rock concerts. | A: Do you like to go to movies? | B: No, but I rent a video once in a while.
arabic: من حين لآخر، بين الحين والآخر
definition_ar: أحياناً، ولكن ليس كثيراً.
examples_ar: أحب تناول الطعام في الخارج من حين لآخر. | يزور والديه من حين لآخر.

examples_en: After running so long, he was out of breath. | She was out of breath after running up the stairs. | By the time we reached the top, we were out of breath. | A: Why are you out of breath? | B: Because I ran here from my house.
definition_ar: صعوبة في التنفس بسبب المجهود البدني.
examples_ar: كانت تلهث بعد صعود الدرج ركضاً. | توقف ليستريح لأنه كان يلهث.

examples_en: His haircut is out of date. | My computer is already out of date. | Don't take medicine that is out of date. | A: I can't find the new road on this map. | B: It's probably out of date.
definition_ar: قديم الطراز أو لم يعد صالحاً أو مفيداً.
examples_ar: ذلك البرنامج قديم جداً وغير محدث. | ملابسه قديمة الطراز قليلاً.

examples_en: He said hello as he passed by his friends. | I saw a big dog passing by my house around two o'clock. | People along the street waved as the parade passed by. | A: Do you know where Ann's house is? | B: Yes, I do. | I pass by it every day when I walk home from school.
definition_ar: الذهاب بجانب مكان أو شخص.
examples_ar: أمر بجانب الحديقة في طريقي إلى العمل. | مر بجانبي دون أن يلقي التحية.

examples_en: He is passing out. | She hit her head on the tree and passed out. | You will pass out if you hold your breath for too long. | A: Is he sleeping? | B: No, he saw some blood and passed out!
definition_ar: فقدان الوعي.
examples_ar: كان الجو حاراً جداً لدرجة أنني كدت أفقد وعيي. | أغمي عليها أثناء الحفل.

definition_en: visit; calI on; pay a call; go to see
examples_en: I will pay a visit to my grandma tomorrow. | We paid a visit to our relatives. | I will pay a visit to them sometime. | A: Let's pay a visit to Kevin. | B: Good idea! | I haven't seen him for a long time.
definition_ar: الذهاب لرؤية شخص أو مكان لفترة قصيرة.
examples_ar: يجب أن نقوم بزيارة لجدتنا في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع. | أخطط للقيام بزيارة إلى المتحف غداً.

examples_en: You should pay attention to road signs when you are driving. | He was not paying attention in class. | Pay attention to me. | A: Does he pay attention to the teacher in class? | B: No, he doesn't. | He only talks to his friends and draws pictures on his desk.
arabic: ينتبه لـ، يولي اهتماماً لـ، يركز على
definition_ar: مراقبة أو الاستماع أو التفكير في شخص أو شيء ما بعناية.
examples_ar: عليك أن تنتبه لتعليمات المعلم. | يرجى الانتباه للطريق أثناء القيادة.

examples_en: pick out one you like! | She picked out a nice dress for the party. | I picked out the best apple in the basket. | A: I want to buy a shirt, but I don't know which color to get. | B: I'll help you pick out a color!
definition_ar: اختيار أو انتقاء شخص أو شيء من بين مجموعة.
examples_ar: ساعدتني في اختيار هدية جميلة لأمي. | هل يمكنك تمييز الشخص الذي سرق حقيبتك؟

examples_en: pick up the hammer. | He picked up the pen and wrote a letter. | She picked up her hat and put it on. | A: This room is a mess! pick up your toys. | B: OK, Mom. | I will.
definition_ar: رفع شيء عن الأرض أو تعلم مهارة جديدة بسهولة.
examples_ar: التقط القلم من على الأرض. | سأقلك من المطار في الساعة الخامسة.

definition_en: bit by bit; one by one; piecemeal
examples_en: He put the puzzle together piece by piece. | She ate the whole cake piece by piece. | He picked up the broken dish piece by piece. | A: How did they move that big sculpture? | B: They took it apart and moved it piece by piece.
definition_ar: بشكل تدريجي أو على مراحل صغيرة.
examples_ar: حللنا اللغز قطعة قطعة. | تم جمع الأدلة قطعة قطعة.

definition_en: play a joke on; play tricks on
examples_en: The dog is playing a trick on the cat. | He got in trouble for playing a trick on his sister. | Don't ever play a trick on me again. | A: I like to untie my brother's shoes, hide his pencils, and put frogs in his bed. | B: That's not nice! | Do you always play tricks on him?
arabic: يخدع، يمزح مع، يوقع في فخ
definition_ar: خداع شخص ما بطريقة مرحة أو أحياناً خبيثة.
examples_ar: قرر الأطفال أن يمزحوا مع معلمهم. | لا تخدع أخاك الصغير.

examples_en: A good coat can protect you from::... you ... the cold. | The helmet protected his head from::... his head ... injury in the crash. | Our dog protects our home from::... our home ... robbers. | A: Why do you put a fence around your flowers? | B: It protects them from::... them ... hungry rabbits.
arabic: يحمي أ من ب، يقي أ من ب
definition_ar: الحفاظ على سلامة شخص أو شيء من الأذى أو الخطر.
examples_ar: ارتدِ قبعة لتحمي رأسك من الشمس. | يجب أن نحمي البيئة من التلوث.

examples_en: He proved to be the strongest. | The man proved to be criminal. | She proved to be an unfaithful friend. | A: Why was the man let out of jail? | B: The fingerprints on the gun proved to be someone else's.
definition_ar: أن يظهر حقيقة شيء ما بعد فترة من الزمن.
examples_ar: تبين أن السياسة الجديدة فعالة جداً. | تبين أن الرحلة أطول مما كان متوقعاً.

examples_en: put down the wire! | When he finished the letter, he put down his pencil. | The bag was too heavy, so I put it down::... it .... | A: Where do you want this box? | B: Just put it down::... it ... by the door, thanks.
definition_ar: وضع شيء على سطح ما أو كتابة شيء ما.
examples_ar: من فضلك ضع حقائبك واجلس. | دون أفكاره في مذكراته.

examples_en: He put off washing his shirt for too long! | Don't put off doing your homework. | You should not put it off::... it ... until tomorrow. | A: Do you like cleaning your room? | B: No. | I put it off::... it ... as long as possible.
definition_ar: تأجيل أو تأخير حدث أو إجراء ما.
examples_ar: اضطررنا لتأجيل الاجتماع إلى الأسبوع القادم. | لا تؤجل واجبك المنزلي.

definition_en: get dressed in; wear; have on
examples_en: He put on his helmet before the game started. | The girl put on her glasses to read. | She put on her swimming suit. | A: Let's go for a walk. | B: OK. | Let me put on my shoes.
definition_ar: ارتداء ملابس أو تشغيل جهاز ما.
examples_ar: الجو بارد في الخارج، لذا ارتدِ معطفك. | ارتدت نظارتها لتقرأ.

examples_en: He put together a house of cards. | The boy put together a model airplane. | Let's put together that puzzle. | A: I think we should put together a ski club. | B: Good idea. | I'll ask my friends at work.
definition_ar: أن تبني أو تتركب أو تنشئ شيئاً بربط أجزاء مختلفة ببعضها.
examples_ar: قضت فترة الظهيرة في تجميع رف الكتب الجديد. | يستغرق الأمر وقتاً لتأسيس عمل تجاري ناجح.

examples_en: I can't put up with cockroaches. | She likes cats, but can't put up with their hair. | He refuses to put up with people who smoke in the bathroom. | A: Ha-Ha! | You're stupid. | You can't do math! | B: Stop it! | I can't put up with your teasing me anymore.
definition_ar: أن تتحمل أو تقبل وضعاً مزعجاً أو شخصاً دون تظلم أو شكوى.
examples_ar: لا أعرف كيف تتحمل جيرانًا بهذا الإزعاج. | كان علينا تحمل التأخير الطويل في المطار.

definition_en: many; not a few; a number of; a lot of
examples_en: There are quite a few fish in the group. | There were quite a few people at the park. | There are quite a few good movies at the cinema. | A: About fifty people went to Kim's birthday party. | B: Wow! | That's quite a few people!
arabic: الكثير من، عدد ليس بقلل، ليس بالقليل
definition_ar: عدد معتبر أو كبير من الأشخاص أو الأشياء.
examples_ar: حضر المؤتمر عدد كبير من الناس هذا العام. | لقد قرأت كتباً عديدة في هذا الموضوع.

definition_en: make A think of B; be reminiscent of; evoke
examples_en: He reminds me of::... me ... his father. | The picture reminds him of::... him ... home. | She reminds me of::... me ... a movie star. | A: Why does this song remind you of::... you ... your grandfather? | B: Because it was his favorite song.
definition_ar: أن تجعل شخصاً يتذكر شيئاً ما أو يفكر في شخص أو شيء مشابه.
examples_ar: هذه الأغنية تذكرني دائماً بطفولتي. | من فضلك ذكرني باجتماعنا غداً.

definition_en: get rid of; take away from
examples_en: She wanted to remove the lock from::... the lock ... the door. | I removed his name from::... his name ... the list. | He removed the ring from::... the ring ... his finger. | A: Whose shoes are those? | B: They're mine. | I'll remove them from::... them ... the room.
arabic: يزيل شيئاً من شيء، يبعد أ عن ب
definition_ar: أن تأخذ شيئاً بعيداً عن مكان أو وضع أو غرض معين.
examples_ar: يجب عليك إزالة البقعة من القميص فوراً. | طلب منه المعلم إزالة قبعته عن رأسه.

examples_en: A big stomach can result from eating too much. | The flood resulted from too much rain. | The fire resulted from a cigarette in the garbage can. | A: Why did you do poorly on the test? | B: It resulted from my not studying last night.
definition_ar: أن يحدث أو يوجد كنتيجة مباشرة لسبب معين.
examples_ar: تنتج العديد من المشكلات الصحية عن عادات الأكل السيئة. | نتج التأخير عن مشاكل تقنية غير متوقعة.

definition_en: immediately; without delay; at once; right now
examples_en: He needs help right away. | She has to go to hospital right away! | Stay there! | I am coming right away! | A: Can you stay for a few more minutes? | B: Sorry. | I have to leave right away.
definition_ar: فوراً؛ بدون أي تأخير.
examples_ar: من فضلك اتصل بي حالاً عندما تستلم هذه الرسالة. | عرفت الإجابة فوراً.

definition_en: find or meet by chance; come across; encounter; discover
examples_en: He was surprised to run across the old record in his friends collection. | She ran across her old boyfriend at the store. | If you run across that file, please let me know. | A: When did you find this great article? | B: I ran across it in yesterday's newspaper.
arabic: يصادف، يعثر على صدفة، يلتقي بصدفة
definition_ar: أن تجد أو تقابل شخصاً أو شيئاً بالصدفة البحتة.
examples_ar: أثناء تنظيف السقيفة، صادفت صورة قديمة. | صادفت معلمها السابق في السوبرماركت.

examples_en: The monster ran after the boy. | The kids ran after the ice cream truck. | The cat ran after the dog. | A: Why is the police officer running after that man? | B: Because he stole that woman's purse.
definition_ar: أن تطارد شخصاً أو شيئاً في محاولة للإمساك به، أو تسعى خلف هدف بحماس.
examples_ar: جرى الكلب وراء الكرة بمجرد إلقائها. | من الحماقة السعي وراء الثروة على حساب صحتك.

examples_en: They had to run away. | He ran away from the bear. | The boy ran away from home. | A: Do you have any pets? | B: I had a puppy, but it ran away two weeks ago.
definition_ar: أن تهرب من مكان أو موقف، غالباً بشكل سري أو دون إذن.
examples_ar: حاول المراهق الهرب من المنزل بعد مشاجرة. | لا يمكنك حل مشاكلك بمحاولة الهرب منها.

examples_en: We've run out of water. | Oh no! | The store ran out of bread! | I ran out of money at the casino. | A: Why did the car stop?! | B: Because we just ran out of gas!
definition_ar: أن ينتهي ما لديك من شيء ولا يعود متاحاً.
examples_ar: نفد الحليب من عندنا هذا الصباح. | نفد الوقود من السيارة على الطريق السريع.

examples_en: He came to see his friend off::... his friend ... on his journey. | We went to see my sister off::... my sister ... at the airport. | Can I come and see you off::... you .... | A: I'm leaving for China tomorrow morning. | B: Okay. | I'll be there at the airport to see you off.
definition_ar: الذهاب إلى محطة أو مطار لتوديع شخص مسافر.
examples_ar: ذهبوا إلى المطار لتوديعه. | جاء والداي لتوديعي في محطة القطار.

examples_en: They set up the bowling pins. | He set up a hot dog stand at the fair. | The campers set up their tent. | A: Have you used the new computer that you got last week? | B: No, I haven't. | It's still in the box because I don't know how to set it up::... it ...!
definition_ar: ترتيب أو تنظيم أو بناء شيء ما.
examples_ar: أسسوا عملاً تجارياً جديداً العام الماضي. | هل يمكنك مساعدتي في إعداد الحاسوب؟

definition_en: hold someone's hand and move it up and down as a greeting
examples_en: They are shaking hands with each other | 'The president shook hands with the prime minister. | I | had the chance to shake hands with the movie star. | A: Do American people bow when they meet each other for the first time? | B: No they don't. | They shake hands with each other
definition_ar: الإمساك بيد شخص وتحريكها للأعلى والأسفل كتحية أو علامة اتفاق.
examples_ar: من الأدب أن تصافح مضيفك. | تصافح الزعيمان مع بعضهما البعض.

examples_en: She wanted to show off her expensive coat. | He showed off his new shoes at school. | The girl showed off her report card to her brother. | A: Look! | I got an A on my test! | B: Stop showing off!
definition_ar: التصرف بطريقة تهدف لجذب الانتباه إلى قدراتك أو ممتلكاتك.
examples_ar: إنه يحب التباهي بسيارته الجديدة. | كانت تستعرض فقط أمام أصدقائها.

definition_en: arrive at a place; turn up
examples_en: The owl showed up late at night. | She showed up three hours late. | The man didn't show up for work. | A: Is Nate coming to the party tonight? | B: Yes. | He said he would show up around 7:00.
definition_ar: الوصول إلى مكان يُتوقع منك الحضور فيه.
examples_ar: لم يحضر إلى الاجتماع. | انتظرت لمدة ساعة، لكنها لم تحضر.

examples_en: They walked side by side. | The trees grew side by side along the river. | They sat side by side on the bench. | A: Do you sit next to Amy at school? | B: Yes I do. | We sit side by side at the same desk.
definition_ar: بجوار بعضهما البعض.
examples_ar: مشيا جنباً إلى جنب على طول الشاطئ. | بُني المنزلان جنباً إلى جنب.

examples_en: He should slow down. | The train slowed down as it reached the station. | She slowed down when she drove by the children. | A: Please slow down! | You're walking too fast. | B: Sorry. | I'll walk more slowly.
definition_ar: تقليل سرعة شيء ما أو أن تصبح أقل نشاطاً.
examples_ar: يجب عليك تخفيف السرعة عند القيادة في المطر. | بدأ الاقتصاد في التباطؤ.

examples_en: He's eaten seven hot dogs so far. | The weather has been dry so far this year. | I have met three new people so far. | A: Are you almost finished with that book? | B: No. | I've only read two chapters so far.
definition_ar: حتى اللحظة الحالية.
examples_ar: حتى الآن، كل شيء يسير وفقاً للخطة. | لقد أنهينا ثلاثة فصول حتى الآن.

definition_en: in the end; eventually; in time
examples_en: sooner or later, he's going to hurt himself. | The police will catch the thief sooner or later. | Don't worry. | She'll be here sooner or later. | A: I love getting into movies for half- price. | B: Be careful. sooner or later they are going to find out that you're not a college student!
arabic: عاجلاً أم آجلاً، في وقت ما
definition_ar: في وقت ما في المستقبل، حتى لو لم تكن متأكداً متى.
examples_ar: عاجلاً أم آجلاً، سيتعين عليك مواجهة الحقيقة. | عاجلاً أم آجلاً، سيدرك خطأه.

definition_en: say bad things about; speak badly of; condemn
examples_en: He began to speak ill of his ex-girlfriend. | The workers spoke ill of the factory owner. | She spoke ill of the man who had married her friend. | A: Why does everybody speak ill of Katie? | B: Because she is greedy and unkind.
definition_ar: قول أشياء غير لطيفة أو سلبية عن شخص ما.
examples_ar: ليس من اللطيف التحدث بسوء عن الآخرين. | هي لا تتحدث بسوء عن أصدقائها أبداً.

definition_en: say good things about; speak highly of; praise
examples_en: He always speaks well of his parents. | The boss spoke well of the new worker. | The teacher speaks well of your son. | A: Do people speak well of her? | B: Yes they do. | They say she's very patient and kind.
definition_ar: قول أشياء إيجابية أو لطيفة عن شخص ما.
examples_ar: الجميع يتحدث بإيجابية عن عملها. | المعلم دائماً يتحدث بإيجابية عن طلابه.

definition_en: use money to pay for something
examples_en: How much did you spend on your pants'? | He spends all his money on::... all his money ... gambling. | I spent too much money on::... too much money ... that trip to Hawaii. | A: How much do you spend on food each week? | B: About $50, I guess. | How about you?
arabic: ينفق على، يصرف في، يستهلك في
definition_ar: دفع المال لشراء أو استئجار شيء ما، أو استخدام الوقت والموارد لغرض محدد.
examples_ar: تميل إلى إنفاق الكثير من المال على الملابس. | يجب على الحكومات أن تنفق المزيد على التعليم.

definition_en: represent; mean; be a sign of
examples_en: The dove stands for peace. | The heart stands for love. | In China the color red stands for good luck. | A: What does your middle initial stand for? | B: The S is for Simon. | It was my grandfather's name
definition_ar: أن يكون اختصاراً أو رمزاً لشيء ما، أو أن يدعم مجموعة معينة من الأفكار.
examples_ar: ماذا يرمز اختصار الناتو؟ | حروف USA ترمز إلى الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية.

definition_en: not go to bed; remain awake
examples_en: The boy stayed up late playing video games. | The children were not allowed to stay up after 9:00. | He had to stay up late to study last night. | A: I went to sleep at 3:00 am last night. | B: Wow! | You stayed up late!
definition_ar: البقاء مستيقظاً وعدم الذهاب إلى السرير في الوقت المعتاد.
examples_ar: سهرنا حتى وقت متأخر لمشاهدة الفيلم. | غالباً ما يسهر الطلاب للدراسة قبل الامتحان.

examples_en: The fish should stick to water. | I tried playing the guitar, but I think I will just stick to piano. | Her doctor said that she should stick to her current diet plan. | A: I promised my parents I would study tonight, but I want to play computer games! | B: Don't play computer games. stick to your promise!
arabic: يلتزم بـ، يتمسك بـ، يثبت على
definition_ar: الاستمرار في فعل أو استخدام شيء ما دون التغيير إلى شيء آخر.
examples_ar: عليك الالتزام بنظامك الغذائي إذا كنت تريد إنقاص وزنك. | من الصعب الالتزام بعادة جديدة.

examples_en: Animals such as monkeys and gorillas are primates. | The store sells electronic goods such as radios, computers, and cameras. | We visited many cities in Italy such as Rome, Venice, and Milan. | A: What does your dad sell in his store? | B: He sells sporting goods, such as basketballs, bicycles, | and shoes.
definition_ar: تستخدم لتقديم مثال أو سلسلة من الأمثلة.
examples_ar: أستمتع بالأنشطة الخارجية مثل التنزه والسباحة. | استثمرت العديد من الدول، مثل اليابان، بكثافة في التكنولوجيا.

examples_en: We should take advantage of the nice weather and go to the beach. | He took advantage of the low prices and bought a dozen pens. | The kids took advantage of the holiday and went to the zoo. | A: Bob works at a CD store. | He can give us a discount! | B: We shouldn't take advantage of him.
definition_ar: الاستفادة الجيدة من فرصة ما، أو استغلال طيبة شخص ما ظلماً لمصلحة الفرد.
examples_ar: يجب أن تستفيد من جلسات التدريب المجانية. | استغل الطقس الدافئ ليذهب للسباحة.

examples_en: The boy takes after his father. | She really takes after her mother. | You really take after your grandfather. | A: Joe is an excellent soccer player. | B: He takes after his father. | He is very good at sports.
arabic: يشبه، يقتفي أثر، يتبعه في الصفات
definition_ar: أن يشبه أحد الوالدين أو قريب أكبر سناً في المظهر أو السلوك أو الشخصية.
examples_ar: يشبه الولد جده في طبعه الهادئ. | الجميع يقول إنها تشبه والدتها.

definition_en: look after; keep an eye on; protect
examples_en: You must promise to take care of them. | The nurse took care of the sick patient. | My mother takes good care of::... good ... me. | A: I'll be gone for one week. | Can you take care of my cat? | B: Yes. | I'll give her food and water, and play with her every day.
arabic: يعتني بـ، يهتم بـ، يتولى أمر
definition_ar: رعاية شخص أو شيء ما، أو التعامل مع مهمة أو مسؤولية.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك الاعتناء بقطتي بينما أنا غائب؟ | تعمل بجد لرعاية عائلتها.

examples_en: He is taking singing lessons::... singing .... | The children take piano lessons::... piano .... | I took lessons in dancing. | A: How did she learn to play the guitar so well? | B: She took lessons for six years.
arabic: يأخذ دروساً، يتعلم، يتلقى حصصاً تعليمية
definition_ar: دراسة موضوع معين أو تعلم مهارة من معلم.
examples_ar: إنه يأخذ دروساً لتعلم كيفية عزف البيانو. | قررت أن تأخذ دروس سباحة هذا الصيف.

examples_en: The helicopter is ready to take off. | She took off before I could say goodbye. | The plane will be taking off on time. | A: Let's go for a drive in the country. | B: Okay! | After I finish eating we'll take off.
definition_ar: مغادرة الأرض وبدء الطيران، أو إزالة شيء ما، خاصة الملابس.
examples_ar: ستقلع الطائرة بعد عشر دقائق. | يرجى خلع قبعتك داخل المبنى.

definition_en: be involved in; join in; participate in
examples_en: I'm sorry. | I don't think you can take part in our game. | It is an honor to take part in the Olympics. | She wanted to take part in the meeting. | A: Are you going to take part in the science fair on Saturday? | B: I want to, but I can't. | I'm going to my grandmother's house on Saturday.
definition_ar: أن يكون الشخص مشاركاً في نشاط أو حدث أو نقاش مع الآخرين.
examples_ar: يشارك العديد من الطلاب في الأنشطة الرياضية. | يجب على المواطنين المشاركة في الانتخابات المحلية.

examples_en: An eclipse takes place every few years. | The 2000 Olympics took place in Sydney, Australia. | The conference will take place at the Hyatt Hote. | A: Where will the school picnic be tomorrow? | B: It'll take place at Simon's Park.
definition_ar: أن يحدث أو يقع شيء ما، خاصة بطريقة منظمة أو مخطط لها.
examples_ar: سيعقد الاجتماع في القاعة الرئيسية. | أقيم الحفل الموسيقي الليلة الماضية.

definition_en: be proud of; pride oneself on
examples_en: He takes pride in his work. | I take pride in my painting. | She took pride in her son's good grades. | A: Your mom always makes delicious food! | B: Yes, she takes pride in her cooking.
arabic: يفخر بـ، يعتز بـ، يبدي اعتزازاً
definition_ar: الشعور بقدر كبير من الرضا والسرور بشأن إنجازات الشخص أو صفاته أو ممتلكاته.
examples_ar: هي تفخر كثيراً بعملها. | إنه يفخر بالحفاظ على حديقته مرتبة.

examples_en: They decided to talk over their problem. | They talked over the plan. | We talked over an idea for the next party. | A: Can you go to the concert with us on Saturday night? | B: I'm going to talk it over::... it ... with my dad tonight.
definition_ar: مناقشة مشكلة أو موضوع بدقة، خاصة قبل اتخاذ قرار.
examples_ar: نحن بحاجة لمناقشة خططنا للمستقبل. | دعنا نتناقش أثناء الغداء.

definition_en: do one after another; do by turns; alternate
examples_en: They took turns skipping. | We take turns watching the baby. | She took turns with her brother on the sled. | A: It's going to be a long trip. | B: Let's take turns driving.
definition_ar: القيام بشيء بالتناوب أو بالتعاقب مع شخص آخر.
examples_ar: يتبادل الأطفال الأدوار في لعب اللعبة. | نتناوب على غسل الأطباق.

definition_en: said to show gratitude for something
examples_en: He says thanks for repairing the spaceship. | Thanks for all your help. | Be sure to say thanks for the wonderful dinner. | A: Thanks for helping me clean my room! | B: No problem. | Now let's go outside and play.
definition_ar: تعبير عن الامتنان موجه لشخص مقابل عمل أو مساعدة محددة.
examples_ar: شكراً لمساعدتك في هذا المشروع. | شكراً على الهدية الرائعة.

definition_en: recall or imagine fondly; dream of
examples_en: He can't stop thinking about the girl. | During the storm, I thought about sunshine. | She thinks about her trip to Paris often. | A: Do you miss your grandmother? | B: Yes, I do. | I think about her every day.
definition_ar: النظر في موضوع أو شخص أو التأمل فيه.
examples_ar: أحتاج إلى التفكير في اقتراحك قبل اتخاذ القرار. | إنها تفكر في تغيير عملها.

definition_en: create a picture or idea in your imagination
examples_en: He thought of a good idea for lunch. | He couldn't think of the answer. | Can you think of a better way. | A: Can you think of a nice place for a vacation? | B: How about Hawaii?
definition_ar: امتلاك رأי معين أو تذكر أو تخيل شيء ما.
examples_ar: لا أستطيع تذكر اسمه الآن. | هل يمكنك التفكير في حل أفضل؟

definition_en: get rid of something; throw out
examples_en: Please throw away your garbage. | I don't want to throw away this old chair. | He was angry because she threw away his favorite old hat. | A: Can I throw away these boxes. | B: Yes you can. | I don't need them.
definition_ar: التخلص من شيء لم يعد مرغوباً فيه أو حاجة إليه.
examples_ar: لا ترمِ تلك الصناديق؛ يمكننا إعادة استخدامها. | تخلص من الصحف القديمة.

definition_en: to be honest; to be frank; in all honesty; honestly; frankly
examples_en: to tell the truth, I ate the sheep. | To tell the truth, I don't like her at all. | To tell the truth, I got up late this morning. | A: How about pizza for dinner? | B: To tell the truth, I don't like pizza. | Can we eat something else?
arabic: الحق يقيق، لكي أقول الحقيقة، صراحة
definition_ar: تُستخدم لتقديم بيان صادق أو اعتراف بكل أمانة.
examples_ar: لكي أقول الحقيقة، لم يعجبني الفيلم على الإطلاق. | لأكون صادقاً، كنت مرعوباً.

definition_en: put on clothes to check the style or fit
examples_en: He is trying on a new sweater. | Can I try these shoes on::... these shoes ...? | He tried on the shorts, but they were too big. | A: I like these pants, but I think they're too small. | B: Try them on::... them .... | Maybe they'll fit.
definition_ar: ارتداء قطعة ملابس لمعرفة ما إذا كانت تناسبك وتبدو جيدة.
examples_ar: هل يمكنني قياس هذه السترة قبل شراؤها؟ | قاست ثلاثة فساتين مختلفة.

definition_en: switch off; shut off; disconnect; unplug
examples_en: turn off the lights. | Please turn off the TV. | I forgot to turn the stove off::... the stove .... | A: Are you using the computer? | B: No, you can turn it off::... it ....
definition_ar: إيقاف تشغيل آلة أو ضوء أو تدفق باستخدام مفتاح أو صمام أو حنفية.
examples_ar: من فضلك أطفئ الأنوار عندما تغادر الغرفة. | لا تنسَ إيقاف تشغيل الحاسوب.

examples_en: turn on the lights. | I want to turn on the air conditioner! | Could you turn the fan on::... the fan ..., please? | A: Let's listen to some music! | B: Okay! | I'll turn on the radio.
definition_ar: جعل آلة أو ضوء أو إمداد يبدأ بالعمل بواسطة مفتاح أو صمام.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك تشغيل المدفأة؟ الجو بارد جداً. | شغلت التلفزيون لمشاهدة الأخبار.

examples_en: He is waiting for the bus. | What are you waiting for? | I have to wait for my clothes to dry. | A: He said he'd be here at 8:00, but it's 8:30. | Should we wait for him? | B: Yes. | Maybe he got lost.
definition_ar: البقاء في مكان ما أو تأجيل فعل معين حتى يحين وقت محدد أو يقع حدث ما.
examples_ar: سأنتظرك في المحطة. | علينا أن ننتظر توقف المطر.

examples_en: It is time for him to wake up. | Wake up! | You're late for work! | She woke up in the middle of the night. | A: Be quiet! | You'll wake up the baby! | B: Sorry. | I'll practice my trumpet outside.
definition_ar: التوقف عن النوم والبدء في اليقظة.
examples_ar: أنا عادةً أستيقظ في الساعة السابعة صباحاً. | الضجيج العالي جعلني أستيقظ.

examples_en: watch out for that hole. | Watch out! | There is a bee on your arm! | The old monkey is very mean, so watch out. | A: I'm going for a bike ride. | B: Watch out for cars!
definition_ar: أن تكون حذراً ومنتبهاً لوجود خطر محتمل.
examples_ar: انتبه! هناك سيارة قادمة. | يجب أن تحذر من الطرق الزلقة.

examples_en: The girl wore out the doll. | He wore out two pairs of socks last year. | She wears her pants out::... her pants ... very quickly. | A: Wow! | Your shoes have a lot of holes! | B: I know. | They wore out because I walked five miles in them everyday.
definition_ar: أن يصبح الشيء تالفاً أو غير صالح للاستخدام بسبب كثرة الاستعمال، أو أن يصيب شخصاً بالإرهاق الشديد.
examples_ar: هذا الحذاء سيبلى قريباً. | المشي لمسافات طويلة أرهقني حقاً.

definition_en: what's the problem; what's the wrong; what's the trouble
examples_en: Mommy says, "what's the matter?" | Please tell me what's the matter with my dog. | She's crying. what's the matter with her. | A: You don't look good. what's the matter? | B: I have a bad headache and I'm very tired.
definition_ar: تستخدم للسؤال عن سبب حزن شخص ما أو وجود مشكلة في شيء ما.
examples_ar: ما خطبك اليوم؟ | ما المشكلة في الحاسوب؟ إنه لا يعمل.

definition_en: worth the time and effort spent
examples_en: It would be worthwhile to stop smoking. | It is worthwhile to study a foreign language. | She thinks it is worthwhile saving money. | A: I haven't been to the new aquarium. | Would it be worthwhile to go? | B: Yes! | They have many beautiful fish and other interesting animals there.
definition_ar: يستحق الوقت أو المال أو الجهد المبذول فيه.
examples_ar: من المجدِ أن تدرس بجد. | كانت الرحلة طويلة، لكنها كانت تستحق العناء.

definition_en: have a desire to do; want to; wish
examples_en: The rabbit would like to fly. | She would like to become a doctor. | They would like to go to the beach. | A: I would like to see that new movie. | Do you want to go? | B: Yes. | Let's go this weekend.
definition_ar: طريقة مهذبة للتعبير عن الرغبة أو التمني للقيام بشيء ما.
examples_ar: أود زيارة اليابان. | هل تود الذهاب في نزهة؟

definition_en: would prefer to; would sooner; prefer
examples_en: He would rather eat Chinese food. | I would rather live in a house than in an apartment. | She would rather be fishing. | A: Would you rather::... you ...? go swimming or play computer games today? | B: I would rather go swimming.
definition_ar: تستخدم للتعبير عن تفضيل شيء على آخر.
examples_ar: أفضل البقاء في المنزل على الخروج. | هو يفضل العمل بمفرده.

examples_en: I have to write back to my friend. | Have you written back to your grandmother? | Please write back to me. | A: Have you heard from Ted yet? | B: Yes. | He sent me a letter last week, and I'm going to write back to him tonight.
definition_ar: الرد على رسالة أو بريد إلكتروني عن طريق الكتابة.
examples_ar: يرجى الرد كتابةً في أقرب وقت ممكن. | سأرد عليك كتابةً غداً.

definition_en: make a note of; put down; take down
examples_en: He wrote down the directions. | Please write down this number. | Her mother told him about his family history and he wrote it down::... it .... | A: May I have your telephone number? | B: Yes, I'll write it down::... it ... for you.
definition_ar: تسجيل المعلومات على الورق أو في صيغة رقمية.
examples_ar: دوّن العنوان قبل أن تنساه. | هل يمكنك تدوين رقم هاتفك لي؟

examples_en: Our crumbs are composed of only the finest ingredients! | The class was composed of students from the US, Canada, and England. | Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen. | A: That's a very interesting sculpture. | B: Yes, it's composed of wood, glass, and old shoes.
definition_ar: أن يكون الشيء مصنوعاً أو مشكلاً من أجزاء أو مواد مختلفة.
examples_ar: تتألف اللجنة من خمسة أعضاء. | يتكون الماء من الهيدروجين والأكسجين.

examples_en: I think you need to clean off your windshield. | You should clean off your desk. | It's very dirty. | He cleaned off the shelf so that his new roommate could use it. | A: When is dinner? | B: In a few minutes. | Please help me clean off the table.
definition_ar: إزالة الأوساخ أو البقايا عن سطح شيء ما.
examples_ar: يرجى تنظيف الطاولة قبل أن نبدأ في الأكل. | أحتاج إلى تنظيف مكتبي قبل أن أغادر.

examples_en: I came across this in the backyard. | Does anyone know what it is? | I came across some old photographs at my parent's house. | She came across her favorite singer's latest album at the record store. | A: Please check my homework. | B: Sure. | If I come across any mistakes, I'll tell you.
definition_ar: أن تجد شيئاً أو تقابل شخصاً بالصدفة.
examples_ar: عثرت على صورة قديمة أثناء تنظيف العلية. | لقد عثر على كتاب نادر في المكتبة.

definition_en: wear fancy clothes for a special occasion
examples_en: Oh... that's just crazy Willy. | He likes to dress up. | Many children dress up as ghosts and monsters on Halloween. | Do I need to dress up for dinner at your parent's house? | A: Why did you buy that suit? | B: I want to dress up for the party.
definition_ar: ارتداء ملابس رسمية أو أنيقة، غالباً لمناسبة خاصة أو للظهور بمظهر أفضل.
examples_ar: علينا أن نتأنق من أجل حفل الزفاف الليلة. | يحب الأطفال التنكر في زي الأبطال الخارقين.

examples_en: Now is not the time to fall asleep! | Don't fall asleep when you are driving! | He falls asleep in class almost every day. | A: You look really tired. | B: I couldn't fall asleep last night.
definition_ar: البدء في النوم.
examples_ar: غفوت أثناء مشاهدة الفيلم. | استغرق الأمر ساعة حتى غفوت.

definition_en: write all of the information needed on a form or application
examples_en: Please, fill out the form. | Everyone has to fill out a customs form when they enter a country. | Can you help me fill out this farm? | I don't understand it. | A: I'd like to apply for a credit card. | B: OK. | Just fill out this form and sign it.
definition_ar: إكمال استمارة أو وثيقة من خلال تقديم المعلومات المطلوبة.
examples_ar: يرجى ملء استمارة الطلب هذه. | قضيت ساعة في تعبئة النماذج الضريبية.

examples_en: in retrospect, maybe the haircut wasn't such a good idea. | In retrospect, I should have studied harder in high school. | You can see all of your past mistakes easily in retrospect. | A: Wow, I am so full! | B: Me, too. in retrospect, we should have ordered only one pizza.
arabic: بأثر رجعي، عند النظر إلى الماضي
definition_ar: النظر إلى حدث أو موقف ماضي بفهم أفضل.
examples_ar: بالنظر إلى الماضي، كان يجب أن أدرس بجدية أكبر. | بالنظر إلى الماضي، كان القرار صحيحاً.

examples_en: on the whole, I really enjoyed my trip to Canada. | On the whole, I enjoyed my time in the United States. | Although there were some slow parts, on the whole the movie was good. | A: What did you think of the test? | B: On the whole, I felt it was quite easy.
definition_ar: عند أخذ كل شيء في الاعتبار؛ بصفة عامة.
examples_ar: بشكل عام، أنا راضٍ عن النتائج. | في المجمل، كان المشروع ناجحاً.

examples_en: In the morning, he set out for the park across the street. | He set out for the market early in the morning. | She packed everything in her car and set out for California. | A: Did Bob leave already? | B: Yeah, he set out early this morning.
arabic: ينطلق في رحلة، يبدأ العمل على
definition_ar: بدء رحلة أو البدء في مهمة مع وضع هدف محدد في الاعتبار.
examples_ar: انطلقوا في رحلة طويلة عبر الصحراء. | بدأت العمل لتصبح موسيقية محترفة.

examples_en: I hate waiting on pigs. | The man who waited on us last night had a French accent. | How many tables can you wait on at the same time? | A: Excuse me, no one has waited on us yet. | B: I am very sorry. | I'll get a waiter right away.
definition_ar: خدمة شخص ما، خاصة في مطعم أو متجر.
examples_ar: سيأتي النادل لخدمتكم على طاولتكم قريباً. | لقد كانت تخدم الزبائن طوال اليوم.

definition_en: like or enjoy in an extreme way
examples_en: He's always been crazy about tomatoes. | She is crazy about tennis. | She plays every day. | My brother is crazy about movies. | He spends all of his money going to see them. | A: I love buying new clothes. | B: Me, too. | I'm crazy about shopping!
definition_ar: أن تحب شيئاً أو شخصاً بشدة.
examples_ar: أخي مغرم بكرة القدم. | إنها مغرمة بتلك الفرقة الجديدة.

examples_en: I think you should call it a day. | Let's call it a day! | Bill, you've been here for 10 hours! | You should call it a day and go home. | A: It's 7:30. | Let's call it a day. | B: Good idea. | See you tomorrow.
definition_ar: التوقف عن العمل في شيء ما لبقية اليوم.
examples_ar: لقد عملنا لمدة عشر ساعات؛ لننهِ العمل لهذا اليوم. | أنا متعب، لننهِ العمل لهذا اليوم.

examples_en: concentrate on the road! | It's too noisy here. | I can't concentrate on my homework. | He had to concentrate on the song to hear the words. | A: Just concentrate on hitting the ball. | B: OK, coach.
definition_ar: توجيه كل انتباهك لشيء معين.
examples_ar: أحتاج إلى التركيز على دراستي. | من الصعب التركيز وسط الضجيج.

definition_en: be friendly with; live or work well together
examples_en: I think it's time we tried to get along with each other. | Everyone in my family gets along well with::... well ... each other. | She does not get along with her mother-in-law. | A: Why aren't you going to Beth's party? | B: I don't get along with her.
definition_ar: أن تكون على علاقة ودية مع شخص ما.
examples_ar: أنا أنسجم جيداً مع زملائي في العمل. | هل تنسجم مع جيرانك؟

definition_en: said when you agree with someone's opinion
examples_en: It's spicy! | You may have a point. | I'll use less pepper next time. | My sister says that I need to spend more time with my family. | She has a point. "That girl only seems stuck-up because she is shy." "You have a point there." | A: The blue shirt looks better, but it's more expensive. | B: You have a point.
arabic: لديه وجهة نظر، محق في رأيه
definition_ar: التعبير عن فكرة أو رأي وجيه أو منطقي.
examples_ar: أعتقد أن لديك وجهة نظر بخصوص تخفيضات الميزانية. | هي محقة عندما تقول إننا بحاجة إلى مزيد من الوقت.

examples_en: more often than not, I have sea food for dinner. | More often than not, he spends his holidays with his parents. | She works late more often than not. | A: We'd better take an umbrella. | B: Right. | It rains more often than not this time of year.
definition_ar: في العادة أو في معظم الأوقات.
examples_ar: في أغلب الأحيان، يصل متأخراً إلى الاجتماع. | في أغلب الأحيان، يتأخر القطار.

examples_en: never mind your hair. | You're in the army now! | Never mind the car's color. | It runs great! | Didn't you wash the dishes yet? never mind. | I'll do them myself! | A: Sorry, we don't have leather bags. | B: Never mind. | I'll look in another store.
arabic: لا تهتم، انس الأمر، لا بأس
definition_ar: تستخدم لإخبار شخص ما بأن الأمر غير مهم أو للتوقف عن القلق بشأنه.
examples_ar: لا تهتم، سأقوم بذلك بنفسي. | لا تهتم بالتكلفة، فقط أنجز الأمر.

examples_en: take a look at that! | The doctor took a look at her foot to see if it was broken. | Please take a look at my essay and let me know what you think of it. | A: Something's wrong with the car. | B: I'll take a look at it after lunch.
definition_ar: فحص أو معاينة شيء ما بشكل سريع.
examples_ar: هل يمكنك إلقاء نظرة على تقريري؟ | سألقي نظرة على المحرك لاحقاً.

examples_en: It turned out to be a sunny day. | The weather looked bad this morning, but it turned out to be a nice day. | He tried to cook a special dinner for his girlfriend, but it didn't turn out well. | A: Good luck with your new project. | B: Thanks! | I'll let you know how it turns out.
definition_ar: أن يحدث بطريقة معينة أو أن تكون له نتيجة معينة.
examples_ar: تبين أن الحفلة كانت نجاحاً كبيراً. | اتضح أنه كان على حق طوال الوقت.

examples_en: I want to wrap up the team tryouts by comparing your heights. | Stand together. | The senator wrapped up his speech by quoting the president. | The parry wrapped up around 3 a.m. after the beer ran out. | A: It's almost lunchtime. | B: OK. | Let's wrap up and go out to eat.
definition_ar: إنهاء أو إكمال شيء ما، أو تغليف شيء بالورق.
examples_ar: دعونا نختتم الاجتماع الآن. | نحتاج إلى إنهاء هذا المشروع بحلول يوم الجمعة.

examples_en: I hate to bring it up::... it ..., but some of the others said that there is something strange about you. | I hate to bring this up::... this ..., but you have some food between your teeth. | When my mother is mad at me she always brings up the time I forgot her birthday. | A: I really don't like the new coffee machine. | B: You should bring it up::... it ... at the next staff meeting.
definition_ar: ذكر موضوع للنقاش أو تربية طفل.
examples_ar: لا تطرح موضوع السياسة أثناء العشاء. | تربت في قرية صغيرة.

definition_en: said to encourage a person to do something
examples_en: May I have another piece? by all means! | "May I have some more chicken?" "by all means!" By all means, take your time and look around the store. | A: Could I borrow your pen? | B: By all means!
definition_ar: تستخدم لإعطاء الإذن أو للتعبير عن الموافقة القوية.
examples_ar: بالتأكيد، تعال إلى الحفلة. | بالتأكيد، أخبرنا إذا كنت بحاجة إلى مساعدة.

examples_en: They met, by chance, at the supermarket. | By chance, the first birthday card she read was from her brother. | They met by chance while they were both vacationing in Hawaii. | A: Where did you get your cat? | B: I found him by chance in the park.
definition_ar: بدون تخطيط أو قصد؛ عن طريق الخطأ أو المصادفة.
examples_ar: التقينا بالصدفة في المطار. | هل رأيته بالصدفة؟

examples_en: OK, now there's nothing to see here. | Please carry on with you day. | After the storm passed, we carried on painting the house. | When the announcement was finished, the class carried on with the lesson. | A: Is everyone back from lunch? | B: Yes. | Let's carry on with the meeting.
definition_ar: أن تستمر في فعل شيء ما.
examples_ar: من فضلك استمر في عملك. | رغم هطول المطر، استمروا في اللعب.

definition_en: say some point is the limit
examples_en: Son, isn't there somewhere we should draw the line? | My parents let me use the car, but they draw the line at allowing me to take long trips. | I don't mind sharing a room, but I draw the line at sleeping in the same bed. | A: Let's go to night club. | B: OK, but I draw the line at doing disco!
arabic: يضع حداً لـ، يرفض تجاوز حدود معينة
definition_ar: وضع حد لما يرغب الشخص في القيام به أو قبوله.
examples_ar: لا أمانع في المساعدة، لكنني أضع حداً عند القيام بعملك بدلاً منك. | هو يضع حداً عند الكذب على أصدقائه.

definition_en: repair; make nice or good again
examples_en: It's a good car, but you may need to fix it up::... it ... a bit. | They fixed up the office by putting in new carpet and painting the walls. | It would cost more to fix up this old boat than to buy a new one. | A: Is John going to buy a new house? | B: No, he's going to fix up his old one.
definition_ar: إصلاح أو تحسين أو ترتيب شيء ما.
examples_ar: إنهم يقومون بإصلاح المنزل القديم. | هل يمكنك ترتيب وقت لنتحدث فيه؟

examples_en: They got lost in the snow storm. | We got lost on the way to the theater. | The directions were not clear, so we got lost. | A: Why are you late? | B: I got lost on the way.
definition_ar: فقدان الطريق أو إخبار شخص ما بالرحيل بفظاظة.
examples_ar: ضللنا الطريق في وسط المدينة. | إذا لم يكن معك خريطة، قد تضل الطريق.

definition_en: time for some action that has been postponed too long
examples_en: It's high time we got out of here! | I think it's high time we fix the heater. | I'm freezing! | My mother said it was high time that I got my hair cut and found a job. | A: It's high time you cleaned your room! | B: Yes, Mom. | I'll do it right away.
definition_ar: تُستخدم للإشارة إلى أن شيئاً ما كان ينبغي القيام به بالفعل ويجب فعله الآن.
examples_ar: لقد حان الوقت لنبدأ التخطيط للمستقبل. | لقد حان الوقت لتعتذر لها.

examples_en: Don't make me lose my temper! | He lost his temper and hit the table with his fist. | It is dangerous to lose your temper while driving. | A: What happened to your hand? | B: I lost my temper and punched the wall!
definition_ar: أن تصبح غاضباً جداً بشكل مفاجئ.
examples_ar: فقد أعصابه عندما رأى الفوضى في المطبخ. | نادراً ما تفقد أعصابها، حتى تحت الضغط.

definition_en: move one's vehicle to the side of the road and stop
examples_en: Could you pull over? | I need to use a washroom! | She pulled over to take a picture of the beautiful scenery by the highway. | The police officer yelled at the driver, "pull over!" | A; I think we're lost. | B: Let's pull over and look at the map again.
definition_ar: قيادة المركبة إلى جانب الطريق والتوقف.
examples_ar: أشار ضابط الشرطة للسائق بالتوقف جانباً. | أحتاج للتوقف جانباً لأتحقق من الخريطة.

definition_en: very cheap; a very good price
examples_en: Wow! | What a steal! | My friend sold me his old car. | It was a steal! | The land next to the river is a steal! | You should buy it. | A: I just bought a DVD player for $95! | B: Wow! | What a steal!
definition_ar: شيء رخيص جداً أو صفقة ممتازة.
examples_ar: كانت هذه السترة بعشرة دولارات فقط؛ لقد كانت صفقة رابحة! | شراء ذلك المنزل بهذا السعر كان صفقة رابحة.

examples_en: The game is at hand. | Now get in there and do you best. | Christmas is at hand. | I have to buy gifts for my family. | When I was a child, my mother was always close at hand. | A: I fear that war is at hand. | B: Don't worry. | I'm sure the countries will reach an agreement.
definition_ar: قريب في الوقت أو المسافة؛ متاح.
examples_ar: اجعل أدواتك في متناول يدك أثناء العمل. | العطلات قريبة جداً.

examples_en: Don't worry. | You'll get better. | His cold got better after he rook a day off work. | Her singing will get better if she practices every day. | A: This movie is boring! | B: Don't worry. | It gets better.
definition_ar: التحسن في الصحة أو اكتساب مهارة أكبر في شيء ما.
examples_ar: أتمنى أن تتحسن صحتك قريباً. | لغتي الإنجليزية تتحسن كل يوم.

examples_en: The male and female fish look more or less the same. | My cousin and I are more or less the same age. | The airline tickets were more or less the same price. | A: Which shirt is better? | B: They are more or less the same quality.
definition_ar: تقريباً أو إلى حد معين.
examples_ar: العمل انتهى تقريباً. | لقد قررت تقريباً ما يجب فعله.

examples_en: Do you have any water on hand? | Do you have any bandages on hand? | I cut myself. | There is a representative on hand twenty-four hours a day to help customers. | A: There's going to be five extra people at the party. | B: No problem. | We have plenty of food on hand.
arabic: متوفر، موجود تحت اليد، جاهز للاستخدام
definition_ar: متاح للاستخدام أو موجود حالياً.
examples_ar: لدينا الكثير من الإمدادات المتوفرة. | هل لديك أي نقود متوفرة؟

examples_en: Little Jimmy was proud of his sculpture of a giraffe, which he'd made on his own::... his .... | She has lived on her own::... her ... since she was twenty-two. | He cooked this whole meal on his own::... his ... without any help from his mother. | A: Do you need help fixing the sink? | B: No, thanks. | I can do it on my own::... my ....
definition_ar: بمفرده أو بدون مساعدة من الآخرين.
examples_ar: أنهت المشروع بمفردها. | يفضل العمل بمفرده.

definition_en: use the name B for A
examples_en: Stop referring to me as::... me ... your 'man'. | I'm not your 'man'! | He referred to his classmate as::... his classmate ... his friend even though they only studied together. | Many people refer to this book as::... this book ... the author's greatest work. | A: What did your teacher say about your paper? | B: He referred to it as::... it ... the work of a genius!
arabic: يُشير إلى أ بـ ب، يُطلق على أ اسم ب
definition_ar: تسمية شخص أو شيء باسم أو لقب معين.
examples_ar: غالباً ما يشير الناس إليه على أنه عبقري. | يُشار إلى هذا النبات باسم الصبار.

examples_en: OK, Billy. | Now, take your time::... your ... and decide. | She took her time::... her ... and made sure she did not make any mistakes on the test. | He is taking his time::... his ... getting ready. | He wants to look nice. | A: I'll be there as soon as I can! | B: Take your time::... your .... | The movie doesn't start until 3:00.
definition_ar: القيام بشيء ما دون استعجال.
examples_ar: خذ وقتك؛ لا داعي للاستعجال. | أخذت وقتها في الإجابة على السؤال.

examples_en: You don't think highly of me, do you? | Her teacher thought highly of her ability to draw. | He doesn't think very highly of::... very ... his neighbors. | A: Mr, Henry is such a great teacher! | B: Yes. | All the students think highly of him.
arabic: يُكنّ احتراماً كبيراً لـ، يقدّر عالياً
definition_ar: أن يكون لديك رأي جيد في شخص أو شيء ما.
examples_ar: مديري يقدّر عملك عالياً. | الجميع يقدّر مهاراتها القيادية عالياً.

definition_en: do or use to see if something works correctly
examples_en: We're ready to try it out::... it .... | Don't buy the bike until you try it out::... it ... first. | I tried out several software programs, but none of them were good. | A: Your skateboard looks really fun. | B: It is! | Why don't you try it out::... it ...?
definition_ar: اختبار شيء أو شخص ما لمعرفة مدى ملاءمته أو فعاليته.
examples_ar: أريد تجربة هذا البرنامج الجديد قبل أن نشتريه. | ستتقدم لتجارب الأداء في مسرحية المدرسة غداً.

examples_en: as of yet, she's never had a boyfriend. | As of yet, he has not been paid by the company. | The date for the final lest has not been announced as of yet. | A: Are the new computers in? | B: I'm sorry, sir. | They have not arrived as of yet.
definition_ar: حتى الوقت الحاضر، وغالباً ما تُستخدم في سياقات النفي.
examples_ar: حتى الآن، لم نتلقَّ أي رد من المدير. | سبب الحادث غير معروف حتى الآن.

examples_en: He has the information at his fingertips::... his .... | I don't have that information at my fingertips::... my ... right now. | Can you wait a minute? | Keep all of your important papers at your fingertips::... your ... at all times. | A: Wow! | Your Palm Pilot is really great! | B: Yeah. | It keeps important information right at my fingertips::... my ....
definition_ar: متاح بسهولة أو يمكن الوصول إليه للاستخدام الفوري.
examples_ar: بفضل الإنترنت، أصبحت كل المعلومات التي تحتاجها في متناول يدك. | تحتفظ بكتبها المرجعية في متناول يدها.

examples_en: It's my brand new refrigerator! | Their brand-new car was stolen yesterday, I bought a brand-new stereo to go with my television and DVD player, | A: Your shoes look very clean. | B: Actually. they're brand-new.
definition_ar: جديد كلياً وغير مستخدم.
examples_ar: اشترى سيارة جديدة تماماً الأسبوع الماضي. | يبدو المنزل جديداً تماماً بعد التجديد.

definition_en: go in front of someone unfairly; interrupt someone talking
examples_en: I hate when people cut in line | I hate it when people cut in line at the movies. | She was telling a joke but her brother cut in and told the rest of it. | A: That man just cut in front of us! | B: How rude!
arabic: يقاطع، يتدخل في الحديث، يقطع الطريق
definition_ar: مقاطعة شخص يتحدث أو التحرك فجأة أمام مركبة أخرى.
examples_ar: من فضلك لا تقاطعني بينما أشرح القواعد. | سيارة أخرى قطعت طريقي فجأة على الطريق السريع.

definition_en: worry about or consider for a long time
examples_en: I know you got a bad grade, but try not to dwell on it. | She could not help dwelling on the fact that her mother 'as sick. | I know you lost your wallet, but try not to dwell on it. | A: I can't stop thinking about my old girlfriend. | B: Don't dwell on her. | I'm sure you will find love again.
definition_ar: التفكير أو الحديث عن شيء لفترة طويلة، خاصة إذا كان أمراً مزعجاً.
examples_ar: ليس من الصحي الإطالة في التفكير في أخطاء الماضي. | تميل إلى الاستغراق في إخفاقاتها بدلاً من المضي قدماً.

examples_en: Hello. | Jimmy? | You'll never believe who I got a hold of! | He couldn't get hold of his friend to tell him the plans were changed. | Please write down a phone number where we can get a hold of you. | A: Did you get a hold of Mike? | B: No. | His line was busy
arabic: يتصل بـ، يتمكن من الوصول إلى، يمسك بـ
definition_ar: التواصل مع شخص ما أو الحصول على شيء أو العثور عليه.
examples_ar: كنت أحاول الاتصال به طوال الصباح. | هل يمكنك التواصل مع المدير من أجلي؟

definition_en: memorize; study to know without thinking
examples_en: He's my favorite! | I've learned all his songs by heart::... all his songs ...! | She can't read music, so she learns all the songs by heart::... all the songs .... | I had to learn the whole book by heart::... the whole book ... in elementary school. | A: How did remember all those math equations? | B: I learned them by heart::... them ....
definition_ar: حفظ شيء جيداً لدرجة القدرة على تكراره دون النظر إليه.
examples_ar: كان على الطلاب حفظ القصيدة عن ظهر قلب. | لقد حفظت كلمات هذه الأغنية عن ظهر قلب.

examples_en: I often mix up my friends' phone numbers. | I mixed up your names. | Could you say that again? | The office mixed up the addresses and sent the wrong forms to the two customers. | A: You are supposed to come tomorrow, not today. | B: Sorry! | I mixed up the dates.
definition_ar: الخلط بين شيئين أو أكثر أو شخصين مع بعضهما البعض.
examples_ar: أنا دائماً أخلط بين اسميهما لأنهما متشابهان في النطق. | لا تخلط بين الملفات؛ حافظ على تنظيمها.

examples_en: The phone call took him by surprise::... him .... | His friend's visit took him by surprise::... him .... | When he asked her to marry him, he took her completely by surprise::... her completely .... | A: I can't believe that your mother joined the army! | B: Yes. | She took us all by surprise::... us all ....
definition_ar: أن يحدث شيء بشكل غير متوقع ويجعل الشخص يشعر بالمفاجأة.
examples_ar: الإعلان المفاجئ فاجأ الجميع. | فاجأنا هطول الأمطار الغزيرة.

definition_en: miss work for some time with permission
examples_en: She took time off to enjoy a vacation in the sun. | I have to take time off next week to go to the doctor. | Our company is very strict about taking time off. | A: Why don't we go to Paris next weekend? | B: I'm not sure if I can take time off work.
definition_ar: أخذ فترة من الوقت بعيداً عن العمل أو الدراسة للراحة أو لأسباب شخصية.
examples_ar: أحتاج إلى أخذ إجازة الأسبوع المقبل لزيارة عائلتي. | قررت أن تأخذ إجازة لتتعافى من مرضها.

examples_en: You should wash your white clothes and colored clothes separately, as a rule. | You should eat less meat and more vegetables, as a rule. | As a rule, the teacher does not like it when students leave early. | A: Do you think I can eat this banana? | B: Well, as a rule, eating is not allowed on the subway.
definition_ar: تُستخدم للإشارة إلى أن شيئاً ما صحيح بشكل عام أو يحدث في معظم الحالات.
examples_ar: كقاعدة عامة، نحن لا نسمح باصطحاب الحيوانات الأليفة إلى المكتب. | كقاعدة عامة، أفضل المشي إلى العمل.

examples_en: I'm at a loss for words. | She was at a loss about what to do with the elephant in the backyard. | I know the man you are talking about, but I'm at a loss to think of his name. | A: I am at a loss as to what to cook for dinner. | B: Let's order pizza!
arabic: في حيرة من أمره، عاجز عن التصرف
definition_ar: أن تكون مرتبكاً أو لا تعرف ماذا تفعل أو تقول في موقف معين.
examples_ar: عجزت عن الكلام عندما سمعت الخبر. | كان في حيرة من أمره بشأن كيفية إصلاح الآلة.

examples_en: We have to come up with a plan. | When did you come up with that idea? | He came up with a plan to solve the problem. | A: You named your dog Tweety? | B: It's the best I could come up with!
definition_ar: أن تقترح أو تفكر في فكرة أو خطة أو حل.
examples_ar: ابتكرت فكرة رائعة للمشروع. | هل يمكنك ابتكار خطة أفضل؟

definition_en: a shorter way to say a name
examples_en: This is my friend Koronotino Calenotangas. | His friends call him KC for short. | My name is Alexander, but you can call me Alex for short. | I work for Seattle Auto Company or SAC for short. | A: What kind of car is that? | B: It's a sport utility vehicle ­ SUV for short.
definition_ar: تُستخدم عند الإشارة إلى صيغة أقصر لاسم أو كلمة.
examples_ar: اسمه روبرت، لكننا نناديه بوب اختصاراً. | تُسمى المنظمة 'الناتو' اختصاراً.

examples_en: in spite of the rain, they went to the beach. | In spite of the bad weather, we will go hiking. | The company kept hiring new employees in spite of its decreasing sales. | A: How was your trip to Mexico? | B: I had a great time in spite of the hurricane!
definition_ar: تُستخدم لإظهار أن شيئاً ما حدث أو صحيح على الرغم من وجود عقبات.
examples_ar: على الرغم من المطر، ذهبنا في نزهة. | نجح على الرغم من الصعوبات الكثيرة.

definition_en: turn and ask A to give B
examples_en: She usually looks to her parents for::... her parents ... support. | You should look to your parents for::... your parents ... help if you don't enough money. | He looked to his best friend for::... his best friend ... advice when he needed a job. | A: Don't worry about the test. | We can study together. | B: It's nice to know that I can look to you for help::... you ... help. | Thanks!
arabic: يعتمد على أ للحصول على ب، يتطلع إلى أ من أجل ب
definition_ar: الاعتماد على شخص أو شيء ما لتوفير شيء معين أو المساعدة.
examples_ar: نحن نتطلع إلى والدينا للحصول على التوجيه. | إنهم يعتمدون على المدير لاتخاذ القرارات النهائية.

definition_en: both A and B do not or are not
examples_en: neither I nor::... | I ... my brother is as tall as our father. | Neither I nor::... | I ... my sister is as beautiful as my mother. | She looked for her professor, but he was neither in his office nor::... in his office ... in the classroom. | A: Neither Jim nor::... | Jim ... | Amy are going to the movie. | B: I guess it's just the two of us then.
arabic: لا أ ولا ب، ليس هذا ولا ذاك
definition_ar: تُستخدم للإشارة إلى أن شخصين أو شيئين أو أكثر غير مشمولين أو ليسوا كذلك.
examples_ar: لم يكن المعلم ولا الطلاب على علم بالتغيير. | لا أخي ولا أختي يحبان القهوة.

examples_en: Excuse me. | Could you point out a barbershop? | The waiter pointed out the chef's special on the menu. | He pointed out the places he visited on the map. | A: Wow! | That girl is really ugly! | B: I should point out that she's my sister.
definition_ar: توجيه الانتباه إلى حقيقة أو شخص معين.
examples_ar: أشارت إلى الخطأ الموجود في التقرير. | أشار إلى أن الوقت بدأ ينفد منا.

examples_en: I had a feeling I'd run into you! | I often run into people I know at the bus stop. | While I was in Hollywood, I ran into a famous actor in the supermarket. | A: What took you so long at the store? | B: I ran into my old elementary school teacher.
definition_ar: أن تقابل شخصاً بشكل غير متوقع أو أن تصطدم بشيء عن طريق الخطأ.
examples_ar: صادفت صديقاً قديماً في المتجر. | واجهنا بعض المشاكل أثناء البناء.

examples_en: He doesn't know very much when it comes to mathematics. | When it comes to explaining difficult subjects, she is the best teacher. | He doesn't know very much when it comes to cars. | A: Can you help me install this computer program? | B: Sorry. when it comes to computers, I am a real dunce.
definition_ar: عبارة تُستخدم لتقديم موضوع جديد أو للتركيز على موضوع محدد.
examples_ar: فيما يتعلق بالطبخ، هو خبير. | هي خجولة جداً فيما يتعلق بالتحدث أمام الجمهور.

examples_en: Eating lots of chocolate will only add to your acne problem. | The flooding only added to the problems caused by the storm. | The new research will add to our understanding of genetics. | A: Mom, why are you giving me your dirty socks? | B: I want to add to your collection.
definition_ar: أن تزيد من كمية أو عدد أو شدة شيء ما.
examples_ar: زادت الموسيقى من الأجواء الاحتفالية. | يرجى إضافة اسمك إلى القائمة.

definition_en: every day for a long time
examples_en: day after day, he waited for her to call back. | Day after day, she waited for a letter, but none came. | He walked past the house day after day without really noticing it. | A: How can that old man just sit in the park day after day? | B: That's a statue.
definition_ar: يحدث بشكل مستمر أو متكرر على مدى فترة طويلة من الزمن.
examples_ar: يوماً بعد يوم، كانت تنتظر عودته. | جلس بجانب النافذة يوماً بعد يوم.

examples_en: She went through a stressful time last year. | He went through some medical tests last week. | When we travel, we always go through the same argument about where to stay. | A: Let's go on the roller coaster one more time! | B: No thanks. | I don't want to go through that again.
definition_ar: أن تمر بموقف صعب أو أن تفحص شيئاً ما بعناية.
examples_ar: كان عليها أن تمر بالكثير من الألم أثناء تعافيها. | أحتاج إلى مراجعة ملاحظاتي قبل الامتحان.

examples_en: I have to eat. | We have to buy more bread. | I have to finish this paper by Monday. | A: Can you go to the movies with me? | B: Sorry. | I have to babysit tonight.
definition_ar: تستخدم للتعبير عن الإلزام أو الضرورة.
examples_ar: يجب أن أنهي هذا التقرير بحلول الليلة. | يجب أن تشاهد هذا الفيلم؛ إنه مذهل.

examples_en: He hit upon a great idea for a birthday gift. | I hit upon a great idea for Amy's party while I was walking to school today. | How old was Einstein when he hit upon the idea of relativity? | A: This banana pizza is delicious! | B: Thanks. | I hit upon the idea while at the zoo yesterday.
definition_ar: أن تكتشف فجأة أو تفكر في فكرة أو حل.
examples_ar: توصل أخيراً إلى الحل الأمثل للمشكلة. | خطرت لها الفكرة أثناء المشي في الحديقة.

examples_en: He's cute, funny, rich, and single. in short, he's perfect! | In short, I believe everyone should vote against the new tax. | In short, I don't want to work here any more. | A: What did you think of the movie? | B: Well in short, it was the worst movie I've seen this year.
definition_ar: تستخدم لتلخيص أو قول شيء ما بإيجاز.
examples_ar: باختصار، نحن بحاجة للعمل بجدية أكبر. | فشلت الخطة؛ باختصار، كانت كارثة.

examples_en: He washed the dishes of his own accord::... his .... | My brother decided to clean the house of his own accord::... his .... | Her parents were going to tell her to get a job, but she got one of her own accord::... her .... | A: Did you put the cat outside? | B: No, he opened the door and went Out of his own accord::... his ....
definition_ar: فعل شيء ما طوعاً دون إجبار.
examples_ar: اعتذر من تلقاء نفسه. | انفتح الباب من تلقاء نفسه.

examples_en: He decided to take care of his nose-hair problem once and for all. | I am going to get rid of those cockroaches once and for all! | He decided to stop smoking once and for all. | A: Where are you going with that hammer? | B: I am going to make that car alarm stop once and for all!
definition_ar: بشكل نهائي وللمرة الأخيرة.
examples_ar: يجب أن نحسم هذا الأمر نهائياً. | أريد إنهاء هذا المشروع بشكل نهائي.

examples_en: Your new hair style might give rise to some problem. | The meeting gave rise to some new plans for the future of the company. | The heavy rain gave rise to an increase in the number of mosquitoes. | A: I don't think we should leave the dog and cat alone together. | B: You're right. | It could give rise to problems.
definition_ar: أن تتسبب في حدوث شيء ما أو وجوده.
examples_ar: سيؤدي القانون الجديد إلى العديد من التحديات القانونية. | أثارت تعليقاته الكثير من التكهنات.

examples_en: He resigned himself to::... himself ... working at the amusement park because he needed the money. | She resigned herself to::... herself ... working in her father's company. | You don't have to resign yourself to::... yourself ... the same kind of life your parents had. | A: Aren't you upset about your test score? | B: No. | I just resigned myself to::... myself ... being a poor student!
definition_ar: أن تتقبل شيئاً غير سار لأنك لا تستطيع تغييره.
examples_ar: رضيت بحقيقة أنها لن تحصل على الوظيفة. | استسلم لفكرة الانتظار الطويل.

examples_en: At times, I feel different. | At times, I wish I had studied something other than medicine. | At times, he can be very cruel. | A: How do you like working in the circus? | B: It's OK. | But, at times, I feel a little bored.
definition_ar: في بعض الأحيان، ولكن ليس دائماً.
examples_ar: يمكن أن يكون صعب المراس أحياناً. | العمل ممل في بعض الأحيان.

examples_en: It's likely to rain this afternoon. | It is likely to snow this afternoon. | Drive carefully. | Someone is likely to ask for your business card. | Do you have any? | A: Let's order some pizza. | B: It's not likely to be open this early in the morning.
